extendedData.name: OracleText
extendedData.value:
The Dominaria United Bundle contains 8 Dominaria United Set Boosters—the best boosters to open just for fun—plus exclusive accessories, with 40 basic lands (20 traditional foils and 20 nonfoils), 1 Traditional Foil promo card with Bundle-exclusive alternate art, 1 oversized Spindown life counter, 1 card storage box, and 2 reference cards.
Each Dominaria United Bundle contains 12 Magic cards, 1 Art Card, and 1 token/ad card or card from “The List” (a special card from Magic's history—found in 25% of packs), with a combination of 1–4 card(s) of rarity Rare or higher and 4–7 Uncommon, 3–6 Common, and 1 Land cards in every pack. Traditional Foil Land replaces Land card in 21% of Set Boosters. Foil-Stamped Signature Art Card replaces Art Card in 10% of Set Boosters.
Contents:
• 8 Dominaria United Set Boosters
•1 foil alt-art promo card
• 40 basic land cards (20 foil + 20 nonfoil)
• Spindown life counter + card storage box
• Return to Magic’s home plane in a set full of your favorite MTG legends and heroes
